test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners, while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides. E is sitting at one of the corners and to the immediate left of F and immediate right of A. H, G and C are exactly sitting opposite to E, A and F, respectively. D is sitting to the immediate right of C. Who among the following is sitting to the immediate right of B?
solution:
**Given:** A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners, while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides.

1) E is sitting at one of the corners and to the immediate left of F and immediate right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/932fe8121ecb27ba556429c706bcc0859c1f0f3aa3c7b4acc0b4e1100cc63db3.png] 

2) H, G and C are exactly sitting opposite to E, A and F, respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fac85074f2787e46e91a710c34cf0a9e04f18f24582b6faae128b41a15739b4.png] 

3) D is sitting to the immediate right of C.

After positioning D only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5b9b75c2faf3143b54efc698da71d72bbe0e58ea17b1a64e071bae2d6bd6aca.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement G is sitting to the immediate right of B.

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.
